interpretation.supported: Within the frozen Qwen3.5 family, increasing size improves true-target recall and tool-contract reliability, but no installed size satisfies the joint safety and recall gate.
interpretation.rejected: Model capacity alone is not a sufficient repair for answer-bearing span authorization over long multilingual session records.
interpretation.remaining_signal: The 9B model reaches 4/8 target-only recall with zero target-removed selections, while two additional records are suppressed by unchanged full-record speakability. This points to evidence representation and safety scope as separate next variables.

next_falsifiable_hypothesis: Projecting each long candidate session into a small source-preserving set of question-aligned user utterances will improve answer-bearing recall for the fixed 4B gate without reintroducing target-removed false selections.
next_experiment_constraints: Use exact source utterances with source offsets; do not summarize or rewrite them.
Keep qwen3.5:4b, the tool carrier, semantic prompt, grounding validator, scores, and selection thresholds fixed.
Change only the evidence representation presented to the span gate.
Do not tune utterance terms on official answers or expected trace IDs.
Keep whole-record speakability fixed in the first representation experiment so safety scope remains a later variable.
Use consumed data for development only and require a new disjoint holdout before runtime.
